 CIO Greatest Hits: Hedge Funds – Dan Fagan (GIC), Craig Bergstrom (Corbin Capital Partners), and Adam Blitz (Evanston Capital) Aug 18, 2025

 This week’s Summer Series is an asset class
twofer covering hedge funds and private equity. The first is a
hedge fund panel comprised of Dan Fagan from GIC of Singapore,
Craig Bergstrom from Corbin Capital Partners, and Adam Blitz from
Evanston Capital. The second is with Mario Giannini, Executive
Co-Chairman of Hamilton Lane. Both offer deep dives into what it
takes successfully invest as an asset class specialist.

 Please enjoy my panel with Dan, Craig, and
Adam from 2023 and with Mario Giannini from 2022.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
